import thinkthen as tt

# the outage first at 0.94, the quote second at 0.93
inbox = ["Newsletter: our autumn catalog is here",
    "Our checkout page is down and customers cannot pay",
    "The client needs the signed quote by 5 pm today.",
    "Reminder: your invoice is due in 30 days"]
for one in tt.rank("Does this need an answer today?",
        inbox, top=2):
    print(one["probability"], one["record"])
